messages:
Ravi (Support): Urgent handoff  trial tenant 'northwind' can't finish onboarding, API returns 403 on provisioning. Ticket #8891. AE Claire flagged as high priority.
Tess (CS): Acknowledge. I'll own customer comms. Ravi, paste the API error and console screenshot text here.
Ravi (Support): Error: `{"status":403,"error":"insufficient_scope"}`. Console shows 'You do not have permission to activate this tenant.'
AE - Claire: Customer note: 'We're demoing Monday; this blocks the pilot. Need fix today.'
Hana (Enablement): I can jump on a 20m screenshare to guide them while we triage. Recommend we offer a temporary token for testing.
Marco (Infra): Quick check  no infra incidents. Likely onboarding job minted key without `provision:write`. Ravi, what's the key id/trace?
Ravi (Support): Key id `trial-northwind-2026`. Trace `z-trc-2001`. I can repro locally and see same 403.
Tess (CS): Proposed comms plan:
- 10m: Send customer note acknowledging and invite to 15m session.
- 30m: Run live repro with support + infra.
- 2h: If unresolved, escalate to SEV and offer 2-week pilot extension.
Hana (Enablement): I'll prep a one-page quickfix doc and share during the call (internal link ready).
Marco (Infra): If scope issue confirmed, I can approve a short-lived test key with `provision:write` for this tenant during the call. Prefer to not issue directly to customer.
Ravi (Support): I will schedule the 15m slot now and include the trace id.
Tess (CS): Draft customer message: "Hi Northwind team, we're on this and have a 15-minute slot at X. We'll attempt a manual activation and temporary test key if needed. Tess, Customer Success"
AE - Claire: Please CC me. If we miss demo, I'll offer the extension & exec note.
Tess (CS): Action owners: Ravi  repro logs + invite; Marco  be ready to approve temp key; Hana  enablement doc + host; Tess  lead customer comms + decide escalation. I'll update thread after call. :white_check_mark:
